scope: All delivered replies in the R76 targeted30 and original-user8 batches, including failed tasks. Earlier partial R73 fact review cannot substitute for this denominator.
before_live_requirements: Every claim about current symptoms, onset, side/site, trigger, tolerated activity and absent symptom must match the current user report or a valid retained user requirement. Quoted other-person symptoms and resolved history remain distinct.

Plan frequency, exercise names, sets/reps/rest/weights and completion counts must match the actual successful tool/SQL sources. A saved preference is not the active plan schedule; prescribed weight is not proven safe load.

If a quantified temporary plan is delivered, independently recompute frequency, weekly sets, time including preparation/rest and return increments; label timing estimates. Missing necessary quantities remain task-completeness defects, not a way to improve accuracy.

General mechanical claims must have an identified source; the two curated variants do not establish other variants or personal tolerance. Individual diagnostic/exclusion/effect guarantees need individual evidence and may remain unsupported.

Food/date/nutrient claims in original user questions must match the scoped tool rows; missing or future dates cannot become zero actual intake or already completed activity. Recorded intake and actual whole-day intake remain distinct.
Claims of tools used, saved state, no change and proposal outcomes must match runtime/SQL lifecycle records. Read-only advice cannot be described as a persisted plan.

record_schema.quote_and_offsets: exact delivered wording; split distinct propositions in shared spans
record_schema.claim_type: user_report | stored_fact | arithmetic | general_fact | inference | state_or_tool_claim
record_schema.evidence: source file/hash and JSON path or primary-source URL; absent evidence explicitly recorded
record_schema.reason: specific evidence comparison, not a copied success label

excluded_from_fact_denominator: Pure preferences, questions, explicitly conditional recommendations and disclosed estimates without factual claims; still reviewed for task fulfillment and safety. Do not omit factual premises embedded inside recommendations.
full_coverage_required: Mark every reply's inventory complete only after all sentences have been considered. Unreviewed replies or unresolved claims keep global accuracy/hallucination metrics null. Do not count obligation checklist items as invented atomic facts.
gate: Existing roadmap thresholds unchanged; at least400 atomic facts per acceptance batch, accuracy98%, critical100%, unsupported/fabricated1% maximum and prohibited individual certainty0. This development batch cannot replace fresh60x2 acceptance batches or real-user evidence.
reviewer: implementation main agent; not independent blind human review
